record.question: They arrived soon after. Identify the part of speech of the underlined word.
record.explanation: Answer A: Adverb. “After” modifies “arrived” by indicating when; it is an adverb. Independent check: “After” has no object following it and means later; it functions as an adverb in “arrived soon after.” Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/after.
